summary: A user reported losing approximately 8000 USD after an attacker sent dust transactions from a lookalike wallet address matching the first and last characters of their own. The user mistakenly labeled the attacker address in Coinbase which auto added it to favorites and later selected it when sending funds resulting in transfer to the attacker.
user_mistake: Selected a lookalike address from favorites without verifying the full string
prevention: Verify full wallet address character by character before confirming transfer / Do not label or favorite addresses from unsolicited dust transactions
